items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: you would get to hear George Duvivier, and Jack Lesberg and Milt Hinton on bases

ctx.x: Oh, yes, I have those sets of the different jazz stars performing also on file. And I would love to furnish those also to the Institute files for the research and digests.

Just quickly, I have one of the late party programs in front of me. For one week we had -- we had for a week long, but each night you would get to hear George Duvivier, and Jack Lesberg and Milt Hinton on bases -- Pee Wee Irwin, Clark Terry, Wild Bill Davison, John Best, on trumpets -- and one of Dr. Fulcher's great loves on tenor saxophone, and personally, is Flip Phillips. He's one of mine, too. I might mention here.

I've done a bunch of recordings with Flip, appeared with him 6 weeks last year at Michael's Pub in New York -- also jazz concerts around New York, and Milt Hinton was in on some of those. Milt, you were with me in Michael's Pub, weren't you, with Flip, among others?
